description: Water Storage In KM Reservoirs is a series of data sets listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset provides detailed information about the water storage capacities of KAHRAMAA (Qatar General Electricity & Water Corporation) reservoirs across various stations in Qatar. The data includes total installed, operating, and non-operating capacities in both imperial gallons (MIG) and cubic meters (M³). The table lists each reservoir/station, the corresponding capacities, and relevant remarks. Coverage: Qatar. The portal lists 5 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are water, reservoirs, storage, infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support reservoir, dam and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
